gloss: Obon festival; Buddhist memorial service for the dead

definitions.gloss: Obon festival; Buddhist memorial service for the dead
definitions.explanation: The formal Buddhist term for the Obon festival, a period when the spirits of ancestors are believed to return to the world of the living. Observed in mid-August (or mid-July in some regions).

examples.japanese: {盂蘭盆会|うらぼんえ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{墓参|ぼさん}り⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I visited the grave during Obon.

examples.japanese: ⟦{寺|てら}→寺：01676_tera⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{盂蘭盆会|うらぼんえ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{法要|ほうよう}→法要：05924_houyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{行|おこな}われた→行う：01238_okonau⟧。
examples.english: An Obon memorial service was held at the temple.

examples.japanese: {盂蘭盆会|うらぼんえ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{時期|じき}→時期：03269_jiki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、{多|おお}く⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{故郷|ふるさと}→故郷：25466_furusato⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{帰省|きせい}→帰省：12419_kisei⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{先祖|せんぞ}→先祖：04040_senzo⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{供養|くよう}→供養：11444_kuyou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: When the Obon period arrives, many people return to their hometowns to honor their ancestors.

notes:
The formal Buddhist name for what is commonly called ⟦お{盆|ぼん}→お盆：05587_obon⟧. The word derives from the Sanskrit "ullambana" (meaning "hanging upside down," referring to the suffering of souls in the afterlife). It is one of the most important annual events in Japan, alongside ⟦{正月|しょうがつ}→正月：01433_shougatsu⟧ (New Year).

During {盂蘭盆会|うらぼんえ}, families welcome ancestral spirits home with ⟦{迎|むか}え{火|び}→迎え火：28983_mukaebi⟧ (welcome fire) and send them back with ⟦{送|おく}り{火|び}→送り火：14488_okuribi⟧ (farewell fire). Many companies give employees time off during this period, and transportation is heavily congested as people travel to their family homes.
